entities.name: Titus Menenius Lanatus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Titus Menenius Lanatus was a Roman patrician who was elected consul for the year 477 BC. He unsuccessfully fought the Veiientes, and was later prosecuted by the tribunes of the plebs for his failure to prevent the disaster of the Cremera.
